description: Returns Nityaflow's workflow design guide: the JSON shape of a workflow, the design rules, and every step type with its settings (schedules, webhooks, WhatsApp, Google Sheets, Gmail, databases, HTTP requests, code, AI replies, checks, approvals, receipts, GST credit matching and client document chasing). For automations, workflows, bots and reminders for businesses, clinics and CA firms, especially in India.
